incidents.reference_summary: In EMEA E2E, Place Search service tasks are with high memory usage.

reference_mitigation_suggestions.investigation: Check the memory usage of the Place Search service tasks and validate is not a normal auto-scaling situation.
reference_mitigation_suggestions.mitigation: Adapt metrics thresholds or evaluation window to avoid false positives.

incidents.reference_summary: In US PROD, Place Search service registered a high number of 5XX errors to history endpoint.

reference_mitigation_suggestions.investigation: Analyze the errors window in the service logs and verify possible provider connection issues.
reference_mitigation_suggestions.mitigation: Contact the provider to check if there are any known issues or outages.

incidents.reference_summary: In US E2E, Place search service tasks stopped unexpectedly.

reference_mitigation_suggestions.investigation: Check if the service tasks are up and running and if there was any deploy or auto-scaling event.
reference_mitigation_suggestions.mitigation: Propose the team to decomission/update this false positive alarm.

incidents.reference_summary: In US PROD, the NetScaler touchpoint detected too many 429 errors.

reference_mitigation_suggestions.investigation: Check the api gateway logs for the specific touchpoint, identify the client causing the 429 errors and check the IFC threshold.
reference_mitigation_suggestions.mitigation: Contact the client to reduce the number of requests or adjust the IFC threshold if the usage is within approved capacity.

incidents.reference_summary: In EMEA PROD, the Usage Analytics Streaming Spark lambda has detected an invocation error.

reference_mitigation_suggestions.investigation: Check the lambda logs for the specific invocation error and check if it is a known issue.
reference_mitigation_suggestions.mitigation: If related with Lambda memory, increase the memory allocation.

incidents.reference_summary: The US PROD monitoring tests have failed (https://atc-github.azure.cloud.bmw/LOS/los-regression-test/actions/runs/36795386).

reference_mitigation_suggestions.investigation: Check the workflow run logs and identify the specific test that failed.
reference_mitigation_suggestions.mitigation: Identify and contact the provider in failure to fix the issue.

incidents.reference_summary: In EMEA E2E, the Place Search service tasks reached their maximum quantity.

reference_mitigation_suggestions.investigation: Check the AWS console and indentify why the increase on the service tasks.
reference_mitigation_suggestions.mitigation: Increase the maximum quantity of tasks or restart them while the issue is not identified.
